do.text: Give every badge a label ("Online", "3 unread"), so its meaning is not colour alone.

dont.text: Don't rely on a coloured dot: colour-blind readers and screen readers miss it.

title: Count the people you cannot show

do.text: End a long stack with a count of the others (`AvatarGroupCount`).

dont.text: Don't cram everyone into a stack: past a few the faces become slivers.
